promises.name: Brian K. Fitzpatrick
promises.quote: And I will continue to protect Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program.

promises.name: Brian K. Fitzpatrick
promises.quote: Congress must act now to secure our borders, respect the rule of law, and show compassion for those legitimately fleeing gang violence and drug cartels.

promises.name: David McCormick
promises.quote: He knows what it’s like to be responsible for the bottom line, and in the Senate he’ll work to rein in government spending, oppose tax increases, and exercise fiscal responsibility to lessen the burden on the people of the commonwealth.
promises.note: Judgment needed: whether the 2025 reconciliation bill counts as cutting spending depends on which baseline you use.

promises.name: David McCormick
promises.quote: As Senator, Dave will fight to secure the border, put an end to drug and human trafficking, and support our border patrol agents with the resources they need to do their jobs.

promises.name: David McCormick
promises.quote: Dave believes we should do even more: he supports increasing the child tax credit to $4,200 per child under the age of 5 and $3,000 for children ages 6 to 17 and giving families the option to receive the credit in monthly installments, from mid-pregnancy to a child’s seventeenth birthday.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the reconciliation bill raised the credit, but by less than the amounts named here.

promises.name: Tim Sheehy
promises.quote: I will work to end the out-of-control spending and the disastrous economic policies that are crushing Montana families and small businesses.
promises.note: Judgment needed: whether the 2025 reconciliation bill counts as cutting spending depends on which baseline you use.

promises.name: Tim Sheehy
promises.quote: We need to take a strong stand and secure our border, finish the wall, and finally put an end to illegal immigration once and for all.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill included border wall funding.

promises.name: Tim Sheehy
promises.quote: We must keep our commitment to every Montana senior to protect their Social Security and Medicare benefits.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Maria Elvira Salazar
promises.quote: There must be protections for people with pre-existing conditions, we must take care of our seniors and protect Medicare, and young adults should be allowed to stay on their parents’ plan up to the age of 26.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Jennifer A. Kiggans
promises.quote: In Congress, Jen is a fierce advocate for seniors and fights to protect and preserve Medicare and Social Security.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Jennifer A. Kiggans
promises.quote: A secure border is a more secure Virginia and a more secure America.

promises.name: Andrew Ogles
promises.quote: America is a nation that recognizes and honors the intrinsic value of all human life; therefore, I will commit to protecting the rights of the unborn from the point of conception, block taxpayer funding of abortions everywhere, and defund Planned Parenthood.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill included a one-year Medicaid funding ban for Planned Parenthood (bundled vote).

promises.name: Andrew Ogles
promises.quote: First and foremost, we must secure our physical border.

promises.name: Chip Roy
promises.quote: I’m also strongly opposed to any taxpayer funding for Planned Parenthood and will fight to stop those resources used to support killing babies.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill included a one-year Medicaid funding ban for Planned Parenthood (bundled vote).

promises.name: Chip Roy
promises.quote: With over $26 trillion in debt eclipsing our economy, we can and must reduce spending, which hasn’t slowed down regardless of the party in power.
promises.note: Judgment needed: whether the 2025 reconciliation bill counts as cutting spending depends on which baseline you use.

promises.name: Derrick Van Orden
promises.quote: Derrick will work tirelessly to stop Democrat tax hikes and make sure more of your hard earned money remains where it should be: in your pocket.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill extended the 2017 tax cuts.

promises.name: Derrick Van Orden
promises.quote: We must regain control of our borders to keep our nation safe.

promises.name: Don Bacon
promises.quote: In Congress, I am backing legislation to secure the border and reform our broken immigration system.

promises.name: Mike Johnson
promises.quote: We will secure the border on day one with a President Trump executive order and then legislation to follow, and we will turn immediately to the economy.
promises.note: From a news item on his campaign site quoting him. As Speaker he may not vote on every bill.

promises.name: Abraham J. Hamadeh
promises.quote: I will work with President Trump to build the wall and will work to pass a bill classifying drug cartels as the terrorist organizations they are.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill included border wall funding.

promises.name: Abraham J. Hamadeh
promises.quote: At a time when Americans are hurting and seeing the value of their dollar devalued, we must do everything we can to preserve Social Security for our seniors.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Young Kim
promises.quote: Californians face the heaviest tax burden of any state in the nation, which is why Young will always fight to lower our taxes.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the reconciliation bill cut some taxes and changed many others.

promises.name: Young Kim
promises.quote: Young will work with anyone who is willing to fix our immigration system while increasing border security.

promises.name: Tom Emmer
promises.quote: Tom is, and always has been, dedicated to reducing Washington’s runaway spending.
promises.note: Judgment needed: whether the 2025 reconciliation bill counts as cutting spending depends on which baseline you use.

promises.name: Steve Scalise
promises.quote: "Defend our liberty, right to life, freedom rights, protect the border and stop illegal immigration!

promises.name: Angela D. Alsobrooks
promises.quote: She believes it’s time for Congress to act to expand Medicaid for millions of Americans that should be covered by the ACA Medicaid expansion but live in the 10 states whose Republican legislators refuse to expand coverage in their states.
promises.note: The reconciliation bill reduced federal Medicaid spending.

promises.name: Adam B. Schiff
promises.quote: Let’s face it – corporations or billionaires should never, ever, pay less taxes than a construction worker.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the reconciliation bill cut some taxes and changed many others.

promises.name: Hakeem S. Jeffries
promises.quote: Hakeem will keep fighting to expand the Child Tax Credit to provide direct relief to working families with kids.
promises.note: Likely mixed: the reconciliation bill raised the Child Tax Credit, and the member's vote was on the bill as a whole.

promises.name: Jared F. Golden
promises.quote: Promised to protect Social Security and increase benefits so that no senior retires in poverty.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Josh Gottheimer
promises.quote: From leading the fight to kill the Congestion Tax, and defending abortion rights, to expanding the Child Tax Credit, I’ll always do what it takes to get things done for Jersey, solve problems, and put your family first.
promises.note: Likely mixed: the reconciliation bill raised the Child Tax Credit, and the member's vote was on the bill as a whole.

promises.name: Ilhan Omar
promises.quote: Repeal the Republican’s 2017 tax scheme that cut taxes for the nation’s highest earners while driving down revenue for important federal programs that support everyday Americans
promises.note: The reconciliation bill made most of the 2017 tax cuts permanent.

promises.name: Ilhan Omar
promises.quote: Strengthen and protect critical Social Security benefits
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Yassamin Ansari
promises.quote: In Congress, I will pursue legislation that helps address asylum processing, visa backlogs and a path to legal status for millions of undocumented immigrants, including essential farmworkers, temporary protected status recipients and Dreamers.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the Laken Riley Act expanded detention; it did not address legal status.

promises.name: Sarah McBride
promises.quote: In Congress, I will be a staunch advocate for coverage, including through Medicaid, for the full range of reproductive health care patients need and to end draconian policies like the global gag rule that limit funds internationally in reproductive health care.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which reconciliation-bill Medicaid changes bear on reproductive health coverage.

promises.name: Jasmine Crockett
promises.quote: We are a nation of immigrants and that will not change but it is time our laws do.
promises.note: Judgment needed: broad statement; the Laken Riley Act is one narrow test.

promises.name: Jared Moskowitz
promises.quote: In Congress, Jared will fight to expand Medicare and protect Social Security.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Jared Moskowitz
promises.quote: A more secure and competitive digital marketplace that incorporates cryptocurrencies and blockchain technologies will secure America’s economy for the next generation.

promises.name: Patrick Ryan
promises.quote: In Congress, Pat's fighting inflation by going after price-gougers who are harming customers, guaranteeing middle-class voters get a tax cut, and making sure billionaires and big corporations pay their fair share.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the reconciliation bill cut some taxes and changed many others.

promises.name: Christopher R. Deluzio
promises.quote: That's why in Congress Chris is fighting to protect and expand Social Security.
promises.note: Judgment needed: which provisions of the reconciliation bill affect these benefits.

promises.name: Christopher R. Deluzio
promises.quote: Chris will work hard to expand Medicare to achieve coverage for all Americans.
promises.note: Judgment needed: the reconciliation bill did not change Medicare eligibility.

promises.name: Ro Khanna
promises.quote: Fighting for Immigration Reform
promises.note: Section heading on the issues page. Judgment needed: broad statement.

promises.name: Pramila Jayapal
promises.quote: Our people-first campaign is counting on grassroots supporters like you to keep Pramila in Congress, where she’ll continue boldly fighting to pass Medicare for All, achieve humane immigration reform, protect workers’ rights, end Big Money's influence in our government, and secure racial, economic, social, and environmental justice.
promises.note: From a fundraising message on her homepage. Judgment needed: broad statement.
